title: VideoPCDNet: Video Parsing and Prediction with Phase Correlation Networks
venueFull: International Conference on Artificial Neural Networks (ICANN)
summary: VideoPCDNet is an unsupervised object-centric framework. It uses frequency-domain phase correlation to break videos into transformed versions of learned object prototypes, which gives interpretable object tracking and future-frame prediction. It outperforms object-centric baselines on several synthetic datasets.
